name: Spice and Silver
content: In this age, spice means wealth, wealth means trouble, and it also means you can be gently squeezed by the tax-collector. Cinnamon, clove, pepper, saffron — each has crossed a thousand mountains from the distant East, and here grows dearer than a life. A woman traveling alone selling spice is herself a suspicious stroke of luck.
gameplay: Spice is the economic loop: stock → enter town → sell at market/noble → tax and costs → fund the next leg. Flaunt wealth and the taxman comes; hoard it and you can't close a sale. The measure between is the play.
